### Bonus: interactive map plot

```{python}
import pandas as pd
gapminder_1997 = pd.read_csv("./data/gapminder_1997.csv")

test = (
    pd.read_csv("./data/gapminder_1997.csv")
    .replace({'country' : {'United States' : 'United States of America',
                           'United Kingdom' : 'United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland',
                          }})
    .merge(pd.read_csv("./data/country-iso.csv")
           .rename(columns={'name' : 'country'}),
           on='country', how='inner')
)

```

```{python}
import altair as alt
from altair.datasets import data

countries = alt.topo_feature(data.world_110m.url, 'countries')

base = alt.Chart(countries).mark_geoshape().project(
    type="equirectangular"
)

base
```

```{python}
base.encode(
    color='lifeExp:Q',
    tooltip=['country:N'],
).transform_lookup(
    lookup='id',
    from_=alt.LookupData(
        test,
        key='country-code',
        fields=['lifeExp', 'country'],
    )
)
```
